summary: This 8-K reports that Innovative Industrial Properties, through indirect subsidiaries, entered into secured term loan agreements with Amalgamated Bank for an aggregate $22.9 million. The loans, consisting of a $10.5 million and a $12.4 million tranche, bear interest at a fixed 6.67% with 25-year amortization and mature June 5, 2031. They are secured by first-priority liens on the respective properties and guaranteed by the parent. This is a routine debt financing, not a special situation. No acquisition, divestiture, or strategic event is involved. Watch for typical debt service and covenant compliance.
